label: Holy site barony
summary: The barony title where the holy site lies.
details: Works on a holy site and leads to a title.

label: Holy site controller
summary: The title that controls the holy site.
details: The game's documentation adds the note "county holder" but lists a title as the result, so it is not clear whether this is the county or its holder. Vanilla never uses it.

label: Holy site county
summary: The county title that the holy site lies in.
details: Works on a holy site and leads to a title.

label: Holy site type
summary: A holy site type picked by its key, for example in `holy_site_type:<key>`.
details: Works from anywhere, no starting scope needed. Vanilla never uses it.

label: Home court
summary: The ruler whose court a hostage comes from.
details: If the character is not a hostage, the result is empty.

label: Host
summary: The character's current host.
details: The game's documentation says nothing more about what counts as a host.

label: House
summary: The dynasty house the character belongs to.

label: House by key
summary: A dynasty house picked by its key, written `house:<key>`.
details: Works from anywhere, no starting scope needed.

label: House confederation
summary: The confederation the house belongs to.

label: House dynasty
summary: The dynasty that the house is part of.

label: House founder
summary: The character who founded the house.

label: House head
summary: The character who currently leads the house.
details: It starts from a house, not from a character, although the game's documentation says "of the scoped character".

label: Imprisoner
summary: The character who holds the scoped character in prison.

label: Initial accolade type
summary: The accolade type the accolade started out with.
details: Works on an accolade and leads to an accolade type.

label: Inspiration
summary: The inspiration the character currently has.
details: It may not exist, if the character has no inspiration.

label: Inspiration owner
summary: The character who owns the inspiration.

label: Inspiration sponsor
summary: The character who sponsors the inspiration.
details: It may not exist, as long as nobody sponsors the inspiration yet.

label: Intent target
summary: The character that this character's current intent is aimed at.
details: The game's documentation does not say which intents exist or what you get without one.

label: Activity they are in
summary: The activity the character is involved in.
details: Vanilla uses it very often.

label: Combat side they fight on
summary: The side of a battle that the army takes part in.
details: Works on an army and leads to a combat side.

label: Faction they joined
summary: The faction the character has joined.

label: Killer
summary: The character who killed this character.

label: Kingdom
summary: The kingdom title that the title or province belongs to by de jure (the map's lawful borders).
details: Works on a title or on a province.

label: Knight's army
summary: The character's knight army.

label: Last house head
summary: The house's last head, by the documented wording; probably the one before the current head.
details: The game's documentation says only "last house head".

label: Last played character
summary: The last character played by the player whose character this is.
details: The game's documentation says it is meant for a player character.

label: Leader
summary: The character who leads the holy order.

label: Leading house
summary: The house that leads the confederation.

label: Legend owner
summary: The character who owns the legend.

label: Legend property
summary: A named property of the legend, written `legend_property:<name>`.
details: The game's documentation says it gives the scope of the property with that name, but does not say what kind of thing that is. Vanilla uses it twice.

label: Legend protagonist
summary: The main character of the legend.

label: Legend type
summary: The type of the legend.

label: Legend type by key
summary: A legend type picked by its key, written `legend_type:<key>`.
details: Works from anywhere, no starting scope needed.

label: Lessee
summary: The character who currently leases the title.

label: Title of the lessee
summary: The lessee's title connected to the leased title.
details: The game's documentation does not say more than that. Vanilla uses it once.

label: Liege
summary: The character's liege, the ruler they answer to.

label: Liege or court owner
summary: The character's liege, or the owner of the court they are in if they have no liege.

label: Open event court owner
summary: The owner of the court in which the local player has an open court event.
details: Works from anywhere. Vanilla never uses it.

label: Local variable
summary: A value set earlier under a local variable name, written `local_var:<name>`.
details: The documented example is `local_var:person_of_interest`. Works from anywhere. Vanilla never uses it.

label: Location
summary: The province where the army, character or combat is.

label: Main holy site
summary: The barony of the religion's main holy site, if one is set.
details: Vanilla never uses it.

label: Main rite
summary: The faith's main rite.

label: Matchmaker
summary: The character's matchmaker.
details: The game's documentation does not say more about how someone becomes a matchmaker.

label: Memory owner
summary: The character whose memory it is.

label: Memory participant
summary: The character who took part in the memory under a given tag, written `memory_participant:<tag>`.
details: Gives the participant stored under that tag in the memory.

label: Mercenary company leader
summary: The character who leads the mercenary company.

label: Mother
summary: The character's mother.

label: Named script value
summary: A script value worked out each time it is used, picked by its name.
details: The number it gives depends on where it is used. Works from anywhere. Vanilla never uses it under this key.

label: Next destination
summary: The next stop of the travel plan. If the traveller is at a stop now, it is the one after it.

label: Next location
summary: The next province the travel plan goes to.
details: The game's documentation words it as the next province the plan goes to, while the next destination key speaks of destination provinces. Vanilla uses it once.
